name: ColumnRFT
description: Reinforcement detailing for ONE floor-to-floor segment of a rectangular concrete column, per specs/column-rft-detailing.md. Ships one button, Column RFT, on the shared RFT-Tools ribbon tab beside the beam tools -- pyRevit merges tabs by title, so this is a separate extension that lands on the same tab. Versioned and released independently of SimpleBeamRFT, as column/vX.Y.Z.
author: Essam Kader
